summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly open-market share repurchases under an existing buyback program announced on 6 January 2026. The company repurchased 1,645,807 ordinary shares (5p each) on the London Stock Exchange over five trading days (18-22 May 2026) via JP Morgan Securities plc as intermediary. Prices ranged from 11.075 to 11.500 GBP per share with volume-weighted average prices between 11.2323 and 11.4215 GBP. Total programme repurchases stand at 32,405,638 shares at a 1,122.8709p average price. The company intends to cancel repurchased shares; trades were executed under UK Listing Rules and Hong Kong Code on Share Buy-Backs, reducing outstanding share count and increasing EPS. Risk-arb angle: None; this is an ongoing capital return program, not a tender offer.
